# Reading Théia through the work it rules today
Archetypes are not metaphors; they are job descriptions written early. **Théia**'s was unusually clear.

Theía has no independent narrative myths; her importance is genealogical and cosmological. Through her, the Titans bequeath light to the Olympian cosmos.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Théia
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Domain of influence:** Titaness of Sight
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Culture & Entertainment · Home & Lifestyle · Energy & Natural World
- **Strongest seat:** Optics, Imaging & Vision
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 238 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Birth of the Luminaries.** Hesiod names Theía as the wife of Hyperion and mother of Hēlios (Sun), Selēnē (Moon), and Eōs (Dawn).  The trio governs the visible heavens; without Theía, there is no source from which these lights can arise. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**Theía in Thessaly.** Pausanias mentions a sanctuary of Theía in Thessaly, where she was honored as mother of the sun.  Her cult was local and relatively rare, overshadowed by the greater worship of her children. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Optics, Imaging & Vision

*Cameras, lenses, biometrics, and imaging science. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*Titaness of sight; vision itself.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Théia performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Gems, Jewelry & Luxury Materials

*Diamonds, gemstones, and precious materials. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*Gold and clear crystal are her materials; radiance is the jeweler's raw stock.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Music, Arts & Performance

*Music, theatre, dance, and the performing arts. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*The theater is a seeing-place; her root thea- names the very act of watching.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Solar & Renewable Energy

*Photovoltaics, solar thermal, and the light economy. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*Titaness of sight and shining, mother of Helios himself.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Théia performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Theía has no independent narrative myths; her importance is genealogical and cosmological. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in optics, imaging & vision, gems, jewelry & luxury materials, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/theia/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
